owner_titles: The Reporting Person is General Counsel and Secretary of Mach Natural Resources GP LLC, the general partner of the Issuer (the "General Partner"). The Issuer is managed by the directors and executive officers of the General Partner.
footnote_text: The Issuer withheld units to satisfy the tax withholding obligations associated with the vesting of phantom units.

The reported securities represent phantom units. Each phantom unit represents the contingent right to receive one common unit of the Issuer upon vesting. The phantom units will vest on the first anniversary of the grant date, subject in each case to the continued service through such dates.
